name: fulltext_build_count
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS matching_entries FROM research_logs_idx
            WHERE dataset=%s AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s)

name: fulltext_abnormal_build_count
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS matching_entries FROM research_logs_idx
            WHERE dataset=%s AND source_file=%s AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2017-05-14 00:00:00'
            AND ts<TIMESTAMP '2017-05-15 00:00:00' AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s)

name: fulltext_selected_build_count
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS matching_entries FROM research_logs_idx
            WHERE dataset=%s AND source_file=%s AND instance_id=%s
            AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2017-05-14 21:42:00' AND ts<TIMESTAMP '2017-05-14 21:44:00'
            AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s)

name: fulltext_selected_build_sample
sql:
SELECT source_file,entry_id,ts,instance_id,component,level,message
            FROM research_logs_idx WHERE dataset=%s AND source_file=%s AND instance_id=%s
            AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2017-05-14 21:42:00' AND ts<TIMESTAMP '2017-05-14 21:44:00'
            AND message @@ ts_phrase(%s) ORDER BY ts,entry_id LIMIT 10
